matrix.legend: PDFs and Videos show how many units that have a PDF or video have their content ingested (indexed / expected). Complete and Incomplete reflect the measured types (exercises, lectures, lecture units, exams, FAQs, channels, course, PDFs, videos). Posts and answers are indexed-only for now. Green: complete. Red: missing or orphaned. Amber: expected count not computed for that type yet. Unknown: the course has only not-yet-measured types indexed.
